correction.label: IMD weather-station grids (rain 0.25 degree, temperature 1 degree)

climate.rain_source: GPM IMERG satellite rainfall, scaled month by month to IMD weather-station grids (rain 0.25 degree, temperature 1 degree) (corrected NASA POWER before 2001 and where IMERG has no file)
climate.ground_label: IMD weather-station grids (rain 0.25 degree, temperature 1 degree)

calibration.reason: The crop grown each year is not known from a map here, so the textbook estimate is not scaled to the satellite record. The two are shown side by side instead.

soil.derived: texture class, K factor and wind erodibility are derived from the mapped sand, silt, clay and organic carbon

vulnerability.method: Each part is scaled 0-1 and averaged: hot days (>40 °C, 10 days = 1), the gap between reference ET and rain, how often greenness fell well below its own normal, and how dry the SMAP soil-moisture pixel normally is.

bare.note: Low green cover is not always bare soil: dormant crops and stubble still protect the surface but look brown from space, and snow or floodwater hides the ground.
